desc: raises flag pole, drives it down into ground, presses firmly

problems: The standing frames (t=0–0.9s) read well. The figure holds the pole upright in two hands, the hands are stacked on the pole and the raise at 0.4s is clear.

The crouch phase (t=1.3–1.8s) reads as a collapse, not a firm downward push. The torso tips into a slanted box with drop 60–68 and lean 0.30–0.35. The head sinks into the shoulder line. The legs almost vanish behind the jacket, so there are no visible bent knees or braced stance.
The flag cloth covers the side of the face and chin from t=1.3 to 1.8s, because the hands at x≈76–78 are too close to the head once the body leans forward.

The drive-down has no visible contact moment. The pole tip is about 75px above the ground at t=0.9 and then pops below the ground line at t=1.3. There is no key where the tip touches the ground and then sinks, so it doesn't read as being driven in.
In the last frame the body stays hunched (drop 55, lean 0.25). A 'presses firmly' finish should end with the figure straightening up, both hands still on a pole that stands upright on its own.

for: plant a flag pole firmly into the ground with both hands
